description: Biomimetic design library condition-mechanism rules. Generated by LLM, pending literature validation.

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Catechol pH-dependent bidentate coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At pH 3-7, catechol hydroxyl groups progressively deprotonate (pKa1 ~ 9.2, pKa2 ~ 12.6 in free catechol; significantly lowered upon metal coordination), enabling stable bidentate coordination bonds with transition metal ions. Coordination capacity increases monotonically with pH in this range.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH 3-7范围内，邻苯二酚的两个羟基逐步去质子化，与过渡金属离子形成稳定的双齿配位键。配位能力随pH升高而单调增强。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Catechol protonation suppresses coordination at low pH
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Below pH 3, both catechol hydroxyl groups are fully protonated. The oxygen lone pairs are engaged in O-H bonds and unavailable for metal coordination, causing a sharp decline (>80%) in coordination capacity with heavy metal ions.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH < 3时，邻苯二酚的两个羟基完全质子化，氧原子孤对电子被O-H键占用，无法与金属离子配位，配位能力骤降超过80%。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Catechol oxidation to quinone at alkaline pH
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Above pH 8, catechol is increasingly susceptible to autoxidation to ortho-quinone. The quinone form lacks the two hydroxyl donors required for bidentate metal coordination, resulting in irreversible loss of chelation capacity. Oxidation rate increases with dissolved O2 and trace metal catalysis.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH > 8时，邻苯二酚易被自动氧化为邻苯醌。醌式结构缺少双齿配位所需的两个羟基供体，导致螯合能力不可逆丧失。氧化速率随溶解氧和痕量金属催化而加快。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Amino group protonation at acidic pH enables anion adsorption
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Below pH ~6.5 (near the pKa of chitosan -NH2, approximately 6.3-6.5), amino groups become protonated to -NH3+. This converts them from neutral metal-coordination ligands to positively charged sites that electrostatically attract anionic species (e.g., Cr2O7 2-, AsO4 3-) while simultaneously suppressing cationic metal coordination.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH < ~6.5（接近壳聚糖氨基pKa ~6.3-6.5）时，氨基质子化为-NH3+，从中性金属配位配体转变为带正电位点，静电吸附阴离子物种（如Cr2O7 2-、AsO4 3-），同时抑制阳离子金属的配位。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Amino group deprotonation enables metal coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At pH 5-9, amino groups progressively deprotonate (-NH3+ to -NH2), freeing the nitrogen lone pair for coordination with transition metal ions (Cu2+, Ni2+, Zn2+, Cd2+). Maximum coordination occurs near pH 7-8 where most amino groups are in the neutral -NH2 form. Above pH 9, metal hydroxide precipitation competes with coordination.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH 5-9范围内，氨基逐步去质子化（-NH3+ 到 -NH2），释放氮原子孤对电子与过渡金属离子（Cu2+、Ni2+、Zn2+、Cd2+）配位。在pH 7-8附近配位达到最大值，此时大部分氨基为中性-NH2形态。pH > 9时金属氢氧化物沉淀与配位竞争。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Carboxyl deprotonation threshold for metal coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Above pH ~4 (near the pKa of alginate guluronic/mannuronic acid carboxyl groups, approximately 3.4-4.4), carboxyl groups deprotonate from -COOH to -COO-. The carboxylate anion is an effective monodentate or bidentate ligand for heavy metal cations, with coordination capacity increasing sharply between pH 3 and pH 5.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH > ~4（接近海藻酸古罗糖醛酸/甘露糖醛酸羧基pKa ~3.4-4.4）时，羧基从-COOH去质子化为-COO-。羧酸根阴离子是重金属阳离子的有效单齿或双齿配体，配位能力在pH 3-5之间急剧增强。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Thiol specificity for soft metal ions via HSAB principle
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Thiol groups (-SH) are soft Lewis bases per Pearson's HSAB theory. They form extremely stable bonds with soft metal ions (Hg2+, Cd2+, Pb2+) with formation constants (log K) of 20-50, while showing negligible affinity for hard metal ions (Ca2+, Mg2+, Fe3+, Cr3+). This provides exceptional selectivity for toxic soft metals in mixed-metal wastewater.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 根据Pearson的HSAB理论，巯基（-SH）是软Lewis碱，与软金属离子（Hg2+、Cd2+、Pb2+）形成极稳定的键（形成常数log K为20-50），而对硬金属离子（Ca2+、Mg2+、Fe3+、Cr3+）几乎没有亲和力。这为混合金属废水中对有毒软金属的卓越选择性提供了基础。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Irving-Williams stability series governs divalent metal selectivity
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: For all N-donor and O-donor ligands (amino, carboxyl, catechol), the stability of divalent metal complexes follows the Irving-Williams series: Mn2+ < Fe2+ < Co2+ < Ni2+ < Cu2+ > Zn2+. Cu2+ complexes are consistently the most stable. This means in competitive multi-metal solutions, Cu2+ will preferentially occupy coordination sites, potentially displacing weaker-binding metals.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 对于所有N供体和O供体配体（氨基、羧基、邻苯二酚），二价金属配合物的稳定性遵循Irving-Williams序列：Mn2+ < Fe2+ < Co2+ < Ni2+ < Cu2+ > Zn2+。Cu2+配合物始终最稳定。这意味着在竞争性多金属溶液中，Cu2+将优先占据配位点，可能置换弱结合金属。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Temperature effect on exothermic coordination adsorption
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Most coordination-based adsorption processes are exothermic (delta-H < 0). Above 50 degrees C, increased thermal energy disrupts metal-ligand coordination bonds, reducing adsorption capacity by approximately 10-30% per 10 degrees C increase. However, moderate heating (20-40 degrees C) may increase adsorption kinetics by improving pore diffusion without significantly affecting equilibrium capacity.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 大多数基于配位的吸附过程是放热的（delta-H < 0）。50度以上时，增加的热能破坏金属-配体配位键，每升高10度吸附容量降低约10-30%。但适度加热（20-40度）可通过改善孔道扩散提高吸附动力学，而不显著影响平衡容量。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Ionic strength enhancement of coordination at moderate salinity
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At moderate ionic strength (I = 0.01-0.5 M, equivalent to ~0.05-3% NaCl), the activity coefficients of charged metal-ligand complexes decrease, thermodynamically favoring complex formation. Adsorption capacity may increase 10-20% compared to deionized water. This is attributed to charge screening reducing electrostatic repulsion between similarly-charged coordination sites.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在中等离子强度（I = 0.01-0.5 M，约0.05-3% NaCl）下，带电金属-配体配合物的活度系数降低，热力学上有利于配合物形成。与去离子水相比，吸附容量可增加10-20%。这归因于电荷屏蔽效应减少了同电荷配位点之间的静电排斥。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: High salinity competition suppresses coordination adsorption
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At high ionic strength (>0.5 M, equivalent to >3% salinity or seawater conditions), competing cations (Na+, K+, Ca2+, Mg2+) saturate coordination sites through mass-action effects. Heavy metal adsorption capacity decreases 30-70% compared to freshwater conditions. The effect is most severe for carboxyl-based coordination (weaker binding) and least severe for catechol-based coordination (stronger binding).
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在高离子强度（>0.5 M，约>3%盐度或海水条件）下，竞争阳离子（Na+、K+、Ca2+、Mg2+）通过质量作用效应饱和配位点。与淡水条件相比，重金属吸附容量降低30-70%。羧基配位（结合较弱）受影响最严重，邻苯二酚配位（结合较强）受影响最小。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Chelate effect: multidentate superiority over monodentate coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Multidentate ligands (bidentate catechol, tridentate catechol-amine combinations) form complexes 10^2 to 10^5 times more stable than equivalent monodentate ligands due to the chelate effect. The thermodynamic origin is primarily entropic: displacing n monodentate waters with one n-dentate ligand releases n-1 additional free molecules, increasing entropy. This explains why mussel-inspired catechol designs outperform simple phenol-based adsorbents.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 多齿配体（双齿邻苯二酚、三齿邻苯二酚-氨基组合）形成的配合物比等效单齿配体稳定10^2到10^5倍，这归因于螯合效应。热力学根源主要是熵效应：一个n齿配体置换n个单齿水分子会释放n-1个额外自由分子，增加熵。这解释了为什么仿贻贝邻苯二酚设计优于简单苯酚基吸附剂。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Redox-sensitive loss of catechol coordination under oxidizing conditions
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Under oxidizing conditions (Eh > +0.3 V at neutral pH, or in the presence of strong oxidants such as Cr(VI), MnO2, or dissolved O2 at high pH), catechol is irreversibly oxidized to ortho-quinone via a two-electron, two-proton process. The quinone form cannot serve as a bidentate O-donor ligand, permanently eliminating metal coordination capacity. This is a critical failure mode for catechol-based adsorbents in oxidizing wastewater.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在氧化条件下（中性pH时Eh > +0.3 V，或存在Cr(VI)、MnO2等强氧化剂，或高pH下溶解氧），邻苯二酚通过双电子双质子过程不可逆氧化为邻苯醌。醌式结构不能作为双齿O供体配体，永久消除金属配位能力。这是邻苯二酚基吸附剂在氧化性废水中的关键失效模式。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Catechol coordination selectivity for borderline-soft metals
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Catechol, as a hard O-donor ligand, preferentially coordinates with borderline and hard metal ions in the order: Fe3+ >> Cu2+ > Pb2+ > Ni2+ > Zn2+ > Cd2+. The exceptionally high affinity for Fe3+ (log K ~ 20 for tris-catecholate complex) is exploited by marine organisms for iron acquisition. For environmental applications, catechol shows highest practical selectivity for Pb2+ and Cu2+ among common heavy metal pollutants.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 邻苯二酚作为硬O供体配体，优先与交界和硬金属离子配位，选择性顺序为：Fe3+ >> Cu2+ > Pb2+ > Ni2+ > Zn2+ > Cd2+。对Fe3+的极高亲和力（三邻苯二酚配合物log K ~ 20）被海洋生物用于铁获取。在环境应用中，邻苯二酚对常见重金属污染物中Pb2+和Cu2+表现出最高的实际选择性。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Amino coordination selectivity follows Irving-Williams for transition metals
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Amino groups coordinate preferentially with borderline metals (per HSAB classification). For divalent transition metals, the selectivity follows: Cu2+ > Ni2+ > Co2+ > Zn2+ > Cd2+ > Mn2+, consistent with the Irving-Williams series. The amino-Cu2+ interaction is particularly strong (log K1 ~ 8-10 for chitosan), making chitosan-based adsorbents highly selective for copper removal from mixed-metal solutions.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 氨基优先与交界金属（按HSAB分类）配位。对于二价过渡金属，选择性遵循：Cu2+ > Ni2+ > Co2+ > Zn2+ > Cd2+ > Mn2+，与Irving-Williams序列一致。氨基-Cu2+相互作用特别强（壳聚糖log K1 ~ 8-10），使壳聚糖基吸附剂对混合金属溶液中铜的去除具有高度选择性。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Alginate egg-box structure enhances Ca2+-mediated coordination stability
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: In the presence of Ca2+ ions, adjacent alginate chains form 'egg-box' junction zones where Ca2+ is coordinated by carboxyl groups from guluronic acid blocks on two parallel chains. This crosslinked structure creates a rigid, stable coordination framework that resists dissolution and provides pre-organized binding sites for heavy metal ion exchange. Egg-box-crosslinked alginate beads show 2-3x higher mechanical stability and improved reusability compared to uncrosslinked forms.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在Ca2+存在下，相邻海藻酸钠链形成'蛋盒'结构连接区，Ca2+被两条平行链上古罗糖醛酸嵌段的羧基配位。这种交联结构创造了刚性稳定的配位框架，抵抗溶解并为重金属离子交换提供预组织结合位点。蛋盒交联海藻酸钙微球比未交联形式表现出2-3倍更高的机械稳定性和改善的可重复使用性。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Thiol oxidation to disulfide eliminates soft metal coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: Under oxidizing conditions (Eh > 0 V at neutral pH), thiol groups undergo oxidative coupling to form disulfide bonds (2 R-SH to R-S-S-R + 2H+ + 2e-). Disulfide bonds are poor ligands for soft metal ions compared to free thiols, resulting in >90% loss of soft metal coordination capacity. SRB-based and thiol-functionalized adsorbents must be protected from oxidizing environments or regenerated with reducing agents (e.g., DTT, mercaptoethanol).
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在氧化条件下（中性pH时Eh > 0 V），巯基发生氧化偶联形成二硫键（2 R-SH 到 R-S-S-R + 2H+ + 2e-）。与游离巯基相比，二硫键是软金属离子的差配体，导致软金属配位能力丧失超过90%。SRB基和巯基功能化吸附剂必须防止氧化环境或使用还原剂（如DTT、巯基乙醇）再生。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Alkali/alkaline earth competitive saturation of coordination sites
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: When background alkali (Na+, K+) and alkaline earth (Ca2+, Mg2+) ions are present at >100x the concentration of target heavy metals (typical in industrial wastewater and seawater), they saturate coordination sites through mass-action effects despite their individually weaker binding constants. This reduces effective heavy metal uptake capacity by 30-70%. Carboxyl-based coordination is most affected; catechol-based and thiol-based coordination are more resistant due to higher intrinsic selectivity.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 当背景碱金属（Na+、K+）和碱土金属（Ca2+、Mg2+）离子浓度超过目标重金属100倍以上（工业废水和海水中典型情况）时，尽管单个结合常数较弱，它们通过质量作用效应饱和配位点。这使有效重金属吸附容量降低30-70%。羧基配位受影响最大；邻苯二酚和巯基配位因固有选择性更高而更具抗性。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Universal proton suppression of all coordination below pH 3
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At pH < 3, excess H+ ions (concentration > 10^-3 M) outcompete all metal cations for coordination sites on all functional groups (catechol, amino, carboxyl, thiol). All amino groups are fully protonated, all carboxyl groups are fully protonated, and catechol hydroxyls are protonated. Coordination-based adsorption of any heavy metal is essentially suppressed. Only electrostatic anion adsorption (via protonated amino groups) and ion exchange mechanisms remain effective in this pH range.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: pH < 3时，过量H+离子（浓度 > 10^-3 M）在所有官能团（邻苯二酚、氨基、羧基、巯基）上与所有金属阳离子竞争配位点。所有氨基完全质子化，所有羧基完全质子化，邻苯二酚羟基质子化。任何重金属的配位吸附基本被抑制。仅静电阴离子吸附（通过质子化氨基）和离子交换机制在此pH范围内仍有效。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Catechol-amino synergistic mixed-ligand coordination
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: When catechol and amino groups are in close molecular proximity (as in DOPA, polydopamine, or co-grafted surfaces), they form synergistic mixed-ligand coordination complexes with metal ions. A metal center can be simultaneously coordinated by catechol O-donors and amino N-donors, creating complexes with overall stability constants 2-5x higher than catechol-only or amino-only systems. This synergistic effect is a key reason why mussel-inspired designs (containing both DOPA and lysine/arginine residues) outperform single-functional-group adsorbents.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 当邻苯二酚和氨基在分子尺度上紧密接近时（如DOPA、聚多巴胺或共接枝表面），它们与金属离子形成协同混合配体配位配合物。金属中心可同时被邻苯二酚O供体和氨基N供体配位，形成的配合物总稳定常数比单独邻苯二酚或单独氨基系统高2-5倍。这种协同效应是仿贻贝设计（同时含DOPA和赖氨酸/精氨酸残基）优于单官能团吸附剂的关键原因。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Metal-to-ligand ratio controls coordination complex stoichiometry
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: At low metal ion concentration relative to available ligand sites (metal:ligand ratio < 1:3), bis- and tris-complexes dominate (metal coordinated by 2-3 ligand molecules), yielding the highest per-metal binding stability. At high metal:ligand ratios (> 1:1), ligand scarcity forces formation of mono-complexes (metal coordinated by only 1 ligand), with lower effective binding constants and higher susceptibility to desorption. This has practical implications for adsorbent regeneration: acidic elution is more effective when metal loading is high.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 当金属离子浓度相对于可用配位点较低（金属:配体比 < 1:3）时，双配合物和三配合物占主导（金属被2-3个配体分子配位），产生最高的单金属结合稳定性。在高金属:配体比（> 1:1）下，配体稀缺迫使形成单配合物（金属仅被1个配体配位），有效结合常数较低且更易脱附。这对吸附剂再生有实际意义：金属负载量高时酸洗脱更有效。

condition_mechanism_rules.title: Carboxyl pH-dependent selectivity shift between hard and borderline metals
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior: In the transitional pH range 3-5, carboxyl groups exhibit a selectivity shift: at pH 3-4 (near pKa), only partially deprotonated -COOH/-COO- sites are available, which preferentially bind hard metal ions (Pb2+, Fe3+) that can displace the remaining proton. At pH 4.5-5, fully deprotonated -COO- sites become abundant, broadening selectivity to include borderline metals (Cu2+, Zn2+, Ni2+, Cd2+). This pH window can be exploited for selective separation of Pb2+ from mixed-metal solutions.
condition_mechanism_rules.behavior_zh: 在过渡pH范围3-5内，羧基表现出选择性转变：在pH 3-4（接近pKa）时，仅部分去质子化的-COOH/-COO-位点可用，优先结合能置换剩余质子的硬金属离子（Pb2+、Fe3+）。在pH 4.5-5时，完全去质子化的-COO-位点大量出现，选择性扩展到交界金属（Cu2+、Zn2+、Ni2+、Cd2+）。可利用此pH窗口从混合金属溶液中选择性分离Pb2+。

design_principle_rules.title: Multivalent Synergy in Bioadhesion
design_principle_rules.context: When designing mussel-inspired, PDA-based, or tannin-based adsorbents for metal ion and organic pollutant removal
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Bioadhesion strength and adsorption performance depend not on a single functional group but on multivalent synergy between catechol, amine, thiol, and crosslinking mechanisms working in concert.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 生物粘附强度和吸附性能不取决于单一官能团，而取决于邻苯二酚、氨基、巯基和交联机制的多价协同效应。

design_principle_rules.title: Hierarchical Structure Advantage
design_principle_rules.context: When designing porous adsorbents inspired by bone, oyster shell, wood, or other biological structures with multi-scale porosity
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Hierarchical porous structures spanning macro-, meso-, and micro-scales simultaneously optimize mass transport kinetics and adsorption capacity, outperforming single-scale porous materials.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 跨越宏观、介观和微观尺度的层次孔结构可同时优化传质动力学和吸附容量，优于单一尺度的多孔材料。

design_principle_rules.title: Bio-to-Material Feature Mapping Methodology
design_principle_rules.context: When translating biological observations into synthetic adsorbent design parameters
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Successful biomimetic design requires systematic mapping from biological features (functional groups, structures, mechanisms) to synthetic material equivalents, preserving functional essence rather than copying morphology.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 成功的仿生设计需要从生物特征（官能团、结构、机制）到合成材料等价物的系统映射，保留功能本质而非简单复制形态。

design_principle_rules.title: Functional Group Density and Adsorption Capacity Relationship
design_principle_rules.context: When optimizing adsorbent surface chemistry for maximum pollutant uptake
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Adsorption capacity scales with accessible functional group density up to a saturation threshold, beyond which steric hindrance and electrostatic repulsion between bound ions diminish returns.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 吸附容量随可及官能团密度的增加而提高，但存在饱和阈值；超过该阈值后，已结合离子间的位阻效应和静电排斥导致边际收益递减。

design_principle_rules.title: Surface Wettability Tuning Strategy
design_principle_rules.context: When designing surfaces for oil-water separation, anti-fouling, or selective wetting applications
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Surface wettability can be rationally tuned across the full spectrum from superhydrophobic to superhydrophilic by co-engineering surface chemistry (surface energy) and hierarchical micro/nano roughness, following the Cassie-Baxter and Wenzel models.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 通过协同调控表面化学（表面能）和层次微纳粗糙度，可按照Cassie-Baxter和Wenzel模型在超疏水到超亲水的全谱范围内理性调控表面润湿性。

design_principle_rules.title: Biomineralization Template Strategy
design_principle_rules.context: When designing inorganic adsorbent materials using biological templates or biomineralization-inspired synthesis
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Biological mineralization processes produce hierarchically ordered inorganic-organic composites with precise crystal orientation and porosity; mimicking these processes enables synthesis of adsorbents with controlled morphology, pore architecture, and active site distribution.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 生物矿化过程产生具有精确晶体取向和孔隙率的层次有序无机-有机复合材料；模仿这些过程可合成具有可控形态、孔结构和活性位点分布的吸附材料。

design_principle_rules.title: Dynamic Responsive Design for Smart Adsorbents
design_principle_rules.context: When designing stimuli-responsive adsorbents that adapt to changing water quality conditions
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Incorporating pH-, temperature-, or light-responsive moieties into biomimetic adsorbents enables on-demand adsorption/desorption switching, facilitating both pollutant capture and material regeneration in a single system.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 在仿生吸附材料中引入pH、温度或光响应基团，可实现按需吸附/脱附切换，在单一系统中同时实现污染物捕获和材料再生。

design_principle_rules.title: Selectivity Design: Molecular Imprinting vs Biological Recognition
design_principle_rules.context: When designing adsorbents with high selectivity for specific target pollutants
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Biological selectivity arises from precise geometric and chemical complementarity (lock-and-key); this can be replicated synthetically through molecular imprinting or by leveraging biological recognition elements (e.g., thiol soft-acid selectivity), each with distinct trade-offs in specificity breadth and synthesis complexity.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 生物选择性源于精确的几何和化学互补性（锁-钥模型）；可通过分子印迹或利用生物识别元件（如巯基的软酸选择性）来合成复制，但两者在特异性广度和合成复杂度上各有权衡。

design_principle_rules.title: Recyclability by Design: Magnetic Separation and Reversible Adsorption
design_principle_rules.context: When designing adsorbents for practical water treatment requiring repeated use cycles
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Practical biomimetic adsorbents must incorporate recyclability from the design stage, achievable through magnetic separability (inspired by magnetotactic bacteria), reversible binding chemistry, or regenerable pore structures.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 实用的仿生吸附材料必须在设计阶段就融入可回收性，可通过磁性分离（受趋磁细菌启发）、可逆结合化学或可再生孔结构来实现。

design_principle_rules.title: Multi-Pollutant Synergistic Removal Strategy
design_principle_rules.context: When designing adsorbents for complex real-world wastewater containing multiple contaminant types
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Real wastewater contains mixed pollutants that can compete for or synergize at adsorption sites; biomimetic designs combining multiple mechanisms (e.g., coordination + electrostatic + catalytic degradation) can achieve simultaneous removal of diverse contaminants.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 真实废水含有可能竞争或协同吸附位点的混合污染物；结合多种机制（如配位+静电+催化降解）的仿生设计可实现多种污染物的同步去除。

design_principle_rules.title: Acid Resistance vs Carboxyl Coordination Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When selecting functional groups for heavy metal adsorption in acidic wastewater (pH < 4)
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Carboxyl-rich adsorbents (alginate, cellulose) offer strong metal coordination capacity but undergo protonation and structural dissolution in acidic conditions, creating a fundamental trade-off between coordination strength and acid stability.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 富含羧基的吸附材料（海藻酸钠、纤维素）具有很强的金属配位能力，但在酸性条件下会发生质子化和结构溶解，形成配位强度与耐酸稳定性之间的根本权衡。

design_principle_rules.title: High Adsorption Capacity vs Fast Kinetics Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When optimizing adsorbent architecture for either maximum uptake or rapid pollutant capture
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Materials optimized for maximum equilibrium adsorption capacity (micropore-dominated, high surface area) typically exhibit slower kinetics due to diffusion limitations, while fast-kinetics materials (meso/macropore-dominated) sacrifice ultimate capacity for rapid mass transport.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 为最大平衡吸附容量优化的材料（微孔主导、高比表面积）通常因扩散限制而动力学较慢，而快速动力学材料（介孔/大孔主导）则以牺牲极限容量换取快速传质。

design_principle_rules.title: High Selectivity vs Broad-Spectrum Removal Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When deciding between targeted pollutant capture and general-purpose water treatment
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Adsorbents designed for extreme selectivity toward one pollutant (e.g., molecular imprinting, thiol-specific soft metals) inherently sacrifice broad-spectrum removal capability, and vice versa -- this is a fundamental design constraint rooted in binding site specificity.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 为单一污染物极高选择性设计的吸附材料（如分子印迹、巯基特异软金属）本质上牺牲了广谱去除能力，反之亦然——这是根植于结合位点特异性的根本设计约束。

design_principle_rules.title: Low Cost vs High Performance Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When balancing economic feasibility against adsorption performance for scalable water treatment
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Naturally abundant biomaterials (oyster shell, chitosan, plant tannin) offer low cost and sustainability but typically show moderate adsorption performance; high-performance materials (MOF, engineered PDA coatings) achieve superior metrics but at significantly higher synthesis cost.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 天然丰富的生物材料（牡蛎壳、壳聚糖、植物单宁）具有低成本和可持续性，但通常吸附性能中等；高性能材料（MOF、工程化PDA涂层）具有优越指标但合成成本显著更高。

design_principle_rules.title: Ease of Synthesis vs Precise Structural Control Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When choosing synthesis routes for biomimetic adsorbents at scale
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Simple synthesis routes (self-polymerization, natural extraction, direct carbonization) enable scalability but yield heterogeneous structures; precise structural control (MOF crystallization, layer-by-layer assembly, 3D printing) improves reproducibility but increases complexity and cost.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 简单的合成路线（自聚合、天然提取、直接碳化）可实现规模化但产生非均质结构；精确结构控制（MOF结晶、层层自组装、3D打印）提高了可重复性但增加了复杂度和成本。

design_principle_rules.title: Environmental Friendliness vs Adsorption Efficiency Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When selecting adsorbent materials considering lifecycle environmental impact
design_principle_rules.core_claim: The most environmentally benign adsorbents (natural biopolymers, unmodified biomass) often show lower adsorption efficiency, while chemical modifications that boost performance may introduce toxic crosslinkers, solvents, or non-degradable components.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 最环保的吸附材料（天然生物高分子、未改性生物质）通常吸附效率较低，而提升性能的化学改性可能引入有毒交联剂、溶剂或不可降解组分。

design_principle_rules.title: Wet-State Stability vs Functional Group Activity Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When designing adsorbents that must maintain performance in aqueous environments over extended periods
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Highly active functional groups (free amines, catechols, thiols) that provide excellent adsorption capacity are also susceptible to oxidation, hydrolysis, or leaching in aqueous environments; crosslinking and encapsulation improve stability but partially block active sites.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 高活性官能团（游离氨基、邻苯二酚、巯基）提供优异吸附容量，但在水环境中也易被氧化、水解或溶出；交联和包封可提高稳定性但部分封闭活性位点。

design_principle_rules.title: Mechanical Strength vs Porosity Trade-off
design_principle_rules.context: When engineering adsorbent mechanical integrity for flow-through or column applications
design_principle_rules.core_claim: Increasing porosity improves adsorption capacity and kinetics but inherently reduces mechanical strength; biological composites (bone, nacre, wood) resolve this trade-off through hierarchical reinforcement strategies that can be mimicked synthetically.
design_principle_rules.core_claim_zh: 增加孔隙率可提高吸附容量和动力学性能，但本质上降低机械强度；生物复合材料（骨骼、珍珠母、木材）通过层次增强策略解决这一权衡，可在合成中模仿。
